A headerless table whose rows have different cell counts is padded, not turned into a list

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<table><tr><td>A</td><td>B</td></tr><tr><td>C</td></tr></table>", options = ConversionOptions$default())
print(result$content)
```
